prompt: Implement a modular Healthcare Patient Monitoring System in C# with three isolated layers: (1) Vital Signs Ingester receiving heart rate and SpO2 telemetry, (2) Anomaly Detection Engine identifying dangerous physiological thresholds using sliding statistical windows, and (3) Emergency Dispatch Subsystem triggering priority SMS/email notifications.
evaluation_criteria:
Module 1 Ingester Score: 0-5 (Evaluates telemetry parsing and thread safety)
Module 2 Detector Score: 0-5 (Evaluates statistical window calculations and threshold triggers)
Module 3 Dispatch Score: 0-5 (Evaluates notification queuing and retry logic)
System Integration Score: 0-5 (Evaluates critical alert latency and fault isolation)
